scenarios.title: A｜和平分手
scenarios.setting: 玩家认真考虑了一段时间，决定结束这段关系。

turns.text: There’s something important I think we need to talk about.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’ve been thinking about us a lot, and I don’t think this relationship is working for me anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been thinking about us a lot, and I don’t think this relationship is working for me anymore.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I care about you, but I don’t think we’re right for each other.

feedback.naturalExpression: I care about you, but I don’t think we’re right for each other.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: This is really difficult to say, but I think we should break up.

feedback.naturalExpression: This is really difficult to say, but I think we should break up.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t want to hurt you, but I don’t think I can continue this relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to hurt you, but I don’t think I can continue this relationship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I want to separate with you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been thinking about us a lot, and I don’t think this relationship is working for me anymore.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达存在语法或语境问题。更建议说：“I’ve been thinking about us a lot, and I don’t think this relationship is working for me anymore.”

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: It’s not about one specific thing. I just don’t think we’re happy together anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s not about one specific thing. I just don’t think we’re happy together anymore.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t think either of us is necessarily at fault. I just think we want different things.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think either of us is necessarily at fault. I just think we want different things.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We’ve tried to make this work, but I don’t think things are getting better.

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ve tried to make this work, but I don’t think things are getting better.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t want to blame you. I just know this isn’t right for me anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to blame you. I just know this isn’t right for me anymore.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I understand. I’m sad, but I think I’ve felt it too.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m sorry it ended this way, but I’m glad we can be honest with each other.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry it ended this way, but I’m glad we can be honest with each other.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I really do wish you the best.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really do wish you the best.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I still care about you, even if we’re not together anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still care about you, even if we’re not together anymore.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜对方试图挽留
scenarios.setting: 在“提出分手”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方试图挽留”。

turns.text: I think we need to end our relationship.
Please don’t do this. We can fix things.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I know you want to try, but I’ve already thought about this for a long time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you want to try, but I’ve already thought about this for a long time.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t think another chance is going to change how I feel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think another chance is going to change how I feel.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand why you want to keep trying, but I’ve made my decision.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand why you want to keep trying, but I’ve made my decision.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: This isn’t something I’m saying because I’m angry. I’m sure about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: This isn’t something I’m saying because I’m angry. I’m sure about it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Stop trying. I’ve already decided.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I know you want to try, but I’ve already thought about this for a long time.
feedback.explanation: 强硬

turns.text: What if we take a break instead? We don’t have to break up.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I don’t think a break is what I want. I think we need to end the relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think a break is what I want. I think we need to end the relationship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand why you’re suggesting that, but I don’t want to give you false hope.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand why you’re suggesting that, but I don’t want to give you false hope.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t think it would be fair to either of us if I stayed when my heart isn’t in it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think it would be fair to either of us if I stayed when my heart isn’t in it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m sorry, but I don’t want to change my decision.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I don’t want to change my decision.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: So there’s really nothing I can do?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m sorry. I know this hurts, but my decision is final.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry. I know this hurts, but my decision is final.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: No. And I don’t want you to feel like you have to convince me.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. And I don’t want you to feel like you have to convince me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think the best thing we can do now is give each other some space.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think the best thing we can do now is give each other some space.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜发生争执
scenarios.setting: 玩家提出分手后，对方情绪变得激动。

turns.text: So you’re just giving up on us? After everything we’ve been through?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m not trying to erase what we had. I’m saying I don’t think we should stay together.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not trying to erase what we had. I’m saying I don’t think we should stay together.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I know we’ve been through a lot, but that doesn’t mean we have to stay in a relationship that isn’t working.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know we’ve been through a lot, but that doesn’t mean we have to stay in a relationship that isn’t working.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand that you’re angry, but I don’t want this to turn into another fight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand that you’re angry, but I don’t want this to turn into another fight.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We can disagree about this, but my decision hasn’t changed.

feedback.naturalExpression: We can disagree about this, but my decision hasn’t changed.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You’re exactly the reason I’m leaving.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not trying to erase what we had. I’m saying I don’t think we should stay together.
feedback.explanation: 容易进一步升级

turns.text: You can’t just decide this on your own!

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I can’t decide how you feel, but I can decide whether I want to stay in the relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t decide how you feel, but I can decide whether I want to stay in the relationship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I know this affects both of us, but I can’t stay just because you don’t want it to end.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know this affects both of us, but I can’t stay just because you don’t want it to end.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m willing to talk about what happens next, but I’m not going to argue about whether I’m allowed to leave.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m willing to talk about what happens next, but I’m not going to argue about whether I’m allowed to leave.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I can’t believe you’re doing this.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I know this is painful. I think we should stop talking for now and give each other some space.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know this is painful. I think we should stop talking for now and give each other some space.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m sorry you’re hurting, but continuing this argument isn’t going to help either of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry you’re hurting, but continuing this argument isn’t going to help either of us.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We can talk again when we’ve both had some time to calm down.

feedback.naturalExpression: We can talk again when we’ve both had some time to calm down.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
